# Ecclesiastes Chapter 2 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**2:1** I-said, I, in-my-heart [be-libbi], "Come now [lekha-na], I-will-test-you [anassekha] with-joy [be-simchah]; and-see [u-re'eh] good [be-tov]." And-behold, also it [is] vapor [havel].

**2:2** To-laughter [li-sechoq] I-said, "Madness [meholal]!" And-to-joy [le-simchah], "What does-this accomplish [mah-zoh oseh]?"

**2:3** I-searched [tarti] in-my-heart to-draw [limshokh] my-flesh [et-besari] with-wine [ba-yayin] — and-my-heart conducting [noheg] with-wisdom [be-chokhmah] — and-to-grasp [le'echoz] folly [be-sikhlut], until I-might-see [er'eh] what [is] good for-the-sons of-the-human [livnei ha-adam] that-they-should-do under the-heavens [in] the-counted days [mispar yemei] of-their-life [chayyeihem].

**2:4** I-made-great [higdalti] my-works [ma'asai]: I-built for-myself houses [battim]; I-planted for-myself vineyards [keramim]. **2:5** I-made for-myself gardens [gannot] and-parks [pardesim], and-I-planted in-them trees [etz] of-every fruit [kol-peri]. **2:6** I-made for-myself pools of-water [berekhot mayim], to-water from-them a-forest [ya'ar] sprouting trees.

**2:7** I-acquired [qaniti] male-servants [avadim] and-female-servants [shefachot], and-sons of-the-house [benei bayit] were to-me; also possession [miqneh] of-cattle [baqar] and-flock [tson], much [harbeh], was to-me above all who-were before-me in-Yerushalayim. **2:8** I-gathered [kanasti] for-myself also silver [kesef] and-gold [zahav] and-treasure [segullah] of-kings and-the-provinces [ha-medinot]; I-made for-myself male-singers [sharim] and-female-singers [sharot] and-the-pleasures [ta'anugot] of-the-sons of-the-human — a-woman [shiddah] and-women [shiddot].

**2:9** And-I-became-great [ve-gadalti] and-I-added [ve-hosafti] above all who-were before-me in-Yerushalayim; indeed [af] my-wisdom [chokhmati] stood [amdah] for-me. **2:10** And-all that my-eyes asked [sha'alu], I-did-not-withhold [lo azalti] from-them; I-did-not-hold-back [lo mana'ti] my-heart from-any joy [simchah], for my-heart was-rejoicing [same'ach] from-all my-toil [amali], and-this was my-portion [chelqi] from-all my-toil.

**2:11** And-I-turned [u-faniti], I, to-all my-works that my-hands had-done and-to-the-toil that-I-had-toiled to-do, and-behold, the-all [ha-kol] [was] vapor [havel] and-striving-after [re'ut] wind [ruach], and-there-is-no profit [yitron] under the-sun.

**2:12** And-I-turned, I, to-see wisdom and-madness [holelot] and-folly [sikhlut]; for what [is] the-human [ha-adam] who-comes after the-king? That-which already they-have-done [asu].

**2:13** And-I-saw, I, that-there-is profit [yitron] to-wisdom [la-chokhmah] over folly [min-ha-sikhlut], as-the-profit of-the-light [ha-or] over the-darkness [ha-choshekh]. **2:14** The-wise-one [he-chakham] — his-eyes [are] in-his-head [be-rosho], and-the-fool [ha-kesil] in-darkness walks. And-I-knew, also I, that one fate [miqreh echad] befalls [yiqreh] them all [et-kullam].

**2:15** And-I-said, I, in-my-heart, "As-the-fate of-the-fool, also I — it-will-befall-me [yiqreni]. And-why [ve-lamah] was-I wise [chakhamti], I, then [az] exceedingly [yoter]?" And-I-spoke in-my-heart that also this [is] vapor [havel]. **2:16** For there-is-no remembrance [zikaron] of-the-wise [le-chakham] with the-fool [im-ha-kesil] to-forever [le-olam], since already [be-she-kevar] in-the-days the-coming [ha-ba'im] the-all [ha-kol] is-forgotten [nishkach]. And-how [ve-eikh] the-wise dies [yamut] with the-fool!

**2:17** And-I-hated [ve-sane'ti] the-life [et-ha-chayyim], for evil [ra] upon-me [was] the-work [ha-ma'aseh] that-is-done under the-sun, for the-all [is] vapor and-striving-after wind.

**2:18** And-I-hated, I, all my-toil [amali] that I [was] toiling under the-sun, that I-must-leave-it [she-annichennu] to-the-human [la-adam] who-will-be after-me. **2:19** And-who knows [yode'a] whether he-will-be wise [chakham] or-foolish [sakal]? And-he-will-rule [ve-yishlat] over-all my-toil that-I-toiled and-that-I-was-wise under the-sun. Also this [is] vapor.

**2:20** And-I-turned, I, to-cause my-heart to-despair [le-ya'esh et-libbi] over all the-toil that-I-toiled under the-sun. **2:21** For there-is a-human [adam] whose-toil [she-amalo] [is] in-wisdom and-in-knowledge [be-da'at] and-in-skill [u-ve-kishron], and-to-a-human who-has-not-toiled in-it he-gives-it [yitnennu] [as] his-portion [chelqo]. Also this [is] vapor and-a-great [rabbah] evil [ra'ah].

**2:22** For what is-there [hoveh] to-the-human in-all his-toil and-in-the-striving [ra'yon] of-his-heart that he toils under the-sun? **2:23** For all his-days [are] pains [makh'ovim], and-vexation [ka'as] [is] his-task [inyano]; also in-the-night [ba-laylah] his-heart does-not lie-down [lo shakhav]. Also this — it [is] vapor.

**2:24** There-is-nothing [ein] good [tov] in-the-human [ba-adam] except-that [she-] he-eats and-drinks [she-yo'khal ve-shahtah] and-shows [ve-her'ah] his-soul [et-nafsho] good in-his-toil. Also this — I-saw, I, that from-the-hand of-God [mi-yad ha-Elohim] it [is].

**2:25** For who eats and-who hastens [yachush] apart-from-me [chutz mimmenni]? **2:26** For to-the-human [la-adam] who [is] good before-him [lifanav] he-gives wisdom [chokhmah] and-knowledge [da'at] and-joy [simchah], and-to-the-sinner [la-chote'] he-gives the-task [inyan] to-gather [le'esof] and-to-heap-up [ve-likhnos], to-give to-the-one-good before God. Also this [is] vapor and-striving-after wind.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.8 — shiddah ve-shiddot:** This is one of the most debated terms in Ecclesiastes. The exact meaning is uncertain — possibly "a woman and women" (concubines), "chests/coffers," or musical instruments. EMET preserves the ambiguity with the literal rendering.

**v.24 — "There is nothing good in the human except that he eats and drinks":** This is the first of Qohelet's "enjoyment passages" (cf. 3:12-13, 3:22, 5:18-19, 8:15, 9:7-9). Note: enjoyment is not earned — it comes "from the hand of God" (*mi-yad ha-Elohim*).

**v.17 — "I hated life":** The Hebrew *sane'ti et-ha-chayyim* is startlingly direct. Qohelet does not hedge — the word is the same used for hating enemies. This emotional honesty is distinctive of wisdom literature.

*-- EMET*
